cases.expected: each thread receives a non‑null, distinct Builder instance
cases.description: Spawn several threads (e.g., 10) that concurrently invoke `JsonSchemaFactory.builder()`. Collect the returned Builder objects and verify that none are null and that all references are unique. This checks that the static `builder()` method is safe to call from multiple threads without sharing state.

group: JsonSchemaFactory.builder() – builder does not retain state after build

cases.expected: second Builder after a build has default configuration
cases.description: Obtain a Builder, call a configuration method on it (e.g., `setUriFactory(customFactory)` if available), then invoke `build()` to create a factory. Afterwards, obtain a new Builder via `JsonSchemaFactory.builder()` and verify that its configuration (e.g., `getUriFactory()`) reflects the defaults, not the custom settings applied to the previous builder. This confirms that the builder does not retain mutable state across separate invocations.
